name: Beat sync
summary: Find a track's tempo and beats and use them to snap cuts and drive pulses, bounces and step lights.
qualityBar: Click tracks 120/90/140 BPM: tempo within 0.3 BPM, phase within 15 ms, onsets within 20 ms
Beds A, D, E at three start offsets: tempo within 0.3 BPM on all nine; A and D phase within 25 ms (measured 1-3 ms); 90%/70% of true beats have an onset within 40 ms
beatPulse is 1 on the beat, decays, rises into the next, no jumps; snapCuts keeps order and gap and leaves far cuts alone
demo_av.mp4: audio reads 107.9 BPM and the three snapped cuts are within 2 ms of a beat found in that file and on a kick onset
